0° lights from the right; −90° from above. Directional colour and exposure follow the person matte. This 2D effect does not reconstruct depth or shadows.

Negative values narrow or shorten; positive values widen or lengthen. The 2D warp follows the largest detected person. Face uses the detected face region; body uses the full silhouette. Nearby background can bend. Review the result.

At −96 dB the gate is off. Raising it suppresses sound below the threshold. Deep/bright voices adjust pitch; radio and robot add original effects.
Records from your microphone on this device and places the take at the playhead. Maximum 10 minutes.
Zero combines the channels into mono, 100 keeps the original width, and 200 doubles their difference. Mono recordings stay centered.
Depth and mix at zero turn tremolo and echo off. Echo repeats must fit within four seconds and stop at the clip boundary. Clip fades also shape the echoes; preview before exporting.
